It is the tally's printed ratio, chosen so that over 12,000 records (C05) render as a countable block of 120 marks rather than as an uncountable field. The frame prints the ratio precisely so the reader can do the arithmetic; the paper publishes no per-mark quantity of any kind.

It is the angular distance on this deck's own season disc between the freeze-up sector broken out on slides 01 and 02 and the flush seam shown here, measured in the artwork's own parallel-oblique construction. It asserts nothing about the world, and in particular it is not a temperature, not a bearing and not a figure from the paper.
